name: meeple-on-board-per-meeple-v1
description: ⚠️ 09/09/2026, THE COMMONS FLIP: THIS ARM NOW PINS THE PASSENGERS AS WELL. Dean ruled the commons in as the engine DEFAULT (docs/commons-handoff-2026-09-09-v1.md), which moved four leaves at once - rules.turn.visitCurrency to 'commons', rules.turn.bonusTiming to 'start', rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour to 0, and the Orchard door's printed draw to 2/2. An overlay that pins only what it is named for stops being the arm it is called, silently, which is the 05/09/2026 lesson written down: NAME THE PASSENGERS BEFORE RULING AN ARM IN. So the `set` below carries every leaf this arm's game relied on, whether or not it was in the original experiment. R17 with a host chosen PER MEEPLE rather than per payment, so one payment may feed several neighbours. Identical to overlays/meeple-on-board-v1.overlay.json in every other respect. It is the rule Dean ruled first on 05/09/2026 and then ruled back on the branching factor, and it survives as the paired arm that says what the ruling cost in play: per meeple multiplies the build enumerator by roughly hosts^meeples and measured at 25,827 ways to buy one building at four seats against 4,063 per payment, with seconds per 4-seat game 0.277 against 0.152. Run it to find out whether the freedom bought anything at the table - the readings to compare are who receives placed meeples (the spread across seats) and the hook.
